selected_gaps.gap: No retrieved paper tests whether all retained regions in one request must share the same representation and retention rule rather than treating that inherited method-wide uniformity as necessary.
selected_gaps.selection_rationale: This is the most load-bearing method gap because ProMixed already produces a useful request-specific block order, yet one method-wide cache format prevents that evidence from controlling how scarce bytes protect different regions. Decompose for Differentiated Treatment closes it by turning retained blocks into byte-priced precision promotions whose distinct treatments are selected from the same ProMixed evidence, while avoiding a new action-damage certificate or a latency-feasibility claim.

selected_gaps.gap: No retrieved frontier leaf closes the gap between offline model-level sensitivity and prompt-specific evidence strongly enough to preserve accuracy across task shifts while keeping selection overhead inside the serving deadline.
selected_gaps.selection_rationale: Under a sequential_pipeline thread, an offline bank of task-category precision-promotion profiles becomes the reference substrate that the runtime prompt fingerprint retrieves before the anchor byte ladder is packed. Adapt by Conditioning closes the shift gap with held-out-task profile transfer using existing ProMixed GQA statistics, not per-task retraining or an online counterfactual model.
